videos.desc:
Is it possible to 3D print a piano that you can actually play? And if so, how good is it? 

I experimented with compliant mechanisms, modular electronics, and more in pursuit of an acoustic-esque key action at a more affordable price. Then, I brought my project to Open Sauce to see what people think!

Contact: dovetaildiy@gmail.com
